sloka: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्देवि देवसमैः कृतम् ।पितुर्वचनमक्लीबम् करिष्यामि पितुर्शितम् ॥२-२१-३३॥
transliteration: etairanyaiśca bahubhirdevi devasamaiḥ kṛtam ।piturvacanamaklībam kariṣyāmi piturśitam ॥2-21-33॥

translations.english: All of them including many other godlike persons, O Mother fulfilled the words of their father. I shall also make my father's wish come true.
